{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data to ensure clean state
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
data['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
data_completed = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = data_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue_completed"}
